SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PHONOLOGICAL
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Phonological helps you succeed in LITERACY ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: PHONOLOGICAL
Study Phonological like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

What this means
In this part you learn to add or substitute individual sounds them(depends on each languag. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: add or substitute individual sounds them(depends on each languag.

3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
